title: croptilon hookerianum var. validum
intro: Croptilon hookerianum var. validum, commonly known as Western Yarrow, is a plant species in the daisy family (Asteraceae) native to Western North America. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Western Yarrow are attributed to its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce fever, and act as an antiseptic and anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents of Western Yarrow include flavonoids, sesquiterpene lactones, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
